mutable_business_configuration.description: A catalog, parameter, threshold, assumption, or fallback that changes with markets, research, strategy judgment, or operations.
mutable_business_configuration.enforcement: Must use an owned, versioned persistence source and a typed read port. Production Python literals are rejected.

domain_invariant.description: A mathematical or semantic invariant whose value is part of the domain definition rather than an operating decision.
domain_invariant.enforcement: Allowed only when the invariant rationale is reviewable and the AST does not match a mutable configuration rule.

schema_or_protocol_constant.description: A stable enum member, field name, protocol discriminator, or validation-schema boundary.
schema_or_protocol_constant.enforcement: Allowed as structure; it must not contain a production catalog, recommendation threshold, allocation assumption, or runtime fallback.

test_fixture.description: Synthetic data used only to exercise guard behavior.
test_fixture.enforcement: Excluded from the production full scan, but negative fixtures are parsed directly by guard self-tests.

contracts.persistence: Versioned Risk Center scenario definitions, revisions, sets, activations, and run evidence
contracts.version_policy: Published revisions are immutable; changes create a replacement version with content hash and activation audit
contracts.initialization: Django data migration with source_type=legacy_code_migration; migration rows are not a runtime fallback

contracts.persistence: Versioned Strategy allocation policy and policy-level adjustment records
contracts.version_policy: Weights, expected metrics, research evidence, and Policy adjustments are immutable per approved version
contracts.initialization: Django data migration from the legacy 4x4 matrix; unverified expected metrics retain legacy_unverified provenance

contracts.version_policy: Threshold changes require a replacement version, change reason, actor, and effective time
contracts.initialization: Legacy thresholds migrate as an explicitly sourced initial policy revision

contracts.persistence: Immutable Portfolio Snapshot net asset value referenced by scenario-run evidence
contracts.version_policy: Every run references one snapshot and as-of time; no arbitrary code default is permitted
contracts.initialization: Caller supplies a real Portfolio Snapshot; missing snapshot fails closed

allowed_invariants.matcher: Enum class members whose literal values define stable protocol or domain identity
allowed_invariants.rationale: Enum identity is structural and does not choose live scenario contents, weights, probabilities, or thresholds.

allowed_invariants.matcher: TypedDict fields, dataclass field declarations, JSON Schema names, and finite validation bounds
allowed_invariants.rationale: Schema shape and safety bounds constrain input; they are not approved production assumptions or catalogs.

allowed_invariants.matcher: Exact dimensional unit conversion multipliers such as 10,000 yuan per wan-yuan
allowed_invariants.rationale: A dimensional identity is mathematically fixed and must not be confused with Policy or allocation multipliers.

allowed_invariants.matcher: Probability or allocation totals equal one within a declared numerical tolerance
allowed_invariants.rationale: Normalization is a mathematical invariant; the individual configured probabilities and weights remain mutable.
